name: wca-orchestrate
description: Route new or revised Wonder Chess assets through AS1; do not redesign gameplay.

name: wca-brief
description: Define scope, identity, parts, budgets and provenance before creating asset references.

name: wca-concept
description: Author or generate identity-locked concept and detail images for an asset; not final mesh evidence.

name: wca-reference
description: Reconcile AI views into a measured construction pack and set up Blender references.

name: wca-blockout
description: Build or revise only the large forms and silhouette of an approved asset reference.

name: wca-organic
description: Refine organic anatomy, face, hands or creature forms; not a whole-character one-shot generator.

name: wca-hard-surface
description: Construct armor, weapons and rigid props with deliberate cross-sections and attachment.

name: wca-costume
description: Build character clothing, layered armor undergarments, hair masses and accessories.

name: wca-review
description: Critique actual asset images or motion against approved references; never self-issue human approval.

name: wca-retopo
description: Build or validate motion-ready/runtime topology from approved forms.

name: wca-uv-bake
description: Unwrap, plan texture density and bake approved source detail onto runtime geometry.

name: wca-material
description: Author coherent stylized materials and textures without using them to hide form errors.

name: wca-rig
description: Build a versioned authoring rig and explicit game export skeleton.

name: wca-skin
description: Initialize, correct and verify deform weights and actual joint motion.

name: wca-motion
description: Author and review complete hero or effect motion with authoritative event timing preserved.

name: wca-optimize
description: Create and validate distance/platform representations without destroying approved identity.

name: wca-unreal
description: Import and verify approved assets in the actual Unreal project and packaged runtime.

name: wca-environment
description: Produce modular arena/environment/foliage assets with assembly and scene readability checks.

name: wca-vfx
description: Design readable skill effects and timing in Unreal; not new combat mechanics.

name: wca-ui
description: Produce game icons, portraits and interface art with small-size and state validation.

name: wca-audio
description: Create or integrate game sound assets with provenance, listening and in-context mix tests.

name: wca-release
description: Prepare final asset promotion after current technical and human acceptance; do not publish automatically.
